resources.string: Hi, I\'m Bothy
One model key is all it takes to start; everything else can be skipped and added later in Settings.
Checking…
1 · Add a DeepSeek key (required)
Bothy thinks and gets things done with DeepSeek, billed by use and cheap. Create an API key on the DeepSeek platform and paste it below.
Get a key on the DeepSeek platform
Ready to go · %1$s
Save and check
2 · (Recommended) Add a Doubao speech key, or skip it

With it, Bothy speaks in Doubao\'s voice and can open the end-to-end voice mode, a continuous conversation like a phone call. It works without one too: Bothy then speaks with the device\'s own system voice. In the Volcano Engine Doubao speech console, under Activation enable Speech Synthesis 2.0 and End-to-end Realtime Speech, then create a key under API Key in the left menu and paste it below.
Enable it in the Doubao speech console
Doubao speech API key
Saved: Bothy will speak in Doubao\'s voice
3 · Grant permissions
Microphone (required)
Talk by voice. The wake word stays off until you turn it on in Settings → Voice
Overlay (required)
Bothy floats over other apps, ready to wake at any time
Notification access (recommended)
See and control the music playing in apps such as NetEase Cloud Music
Accessibility (optional)
Let Bothy operate other apps for you (open, tap, type)
Run in the background (optional)
Keeps the system from clearing it to save battery; some systems also need Auto-start turned on here
On
Turn on
4 · Try saying
Tap the floating Bothy, or the mic in the console, then:
Bothy Playground is installed: open it and keep it in front, and Bothy is in the virtual head unit, where it can turn on the air conditioning, open the windows and navigate.
Open Bothy Playground
Get started
What\'s the weather in Shenzhen tomorrow
Remind me to take an umbrella at eight tomorrow morning
What song is playing (turn on notification access first)
Open the calculator and work out 23 times 47 (turn on accessibility first)
